mods.name: ClickGuard
mods.description: An auto clicker mod for Fabric that lets you automate any keybind, with smart safety features like auto-disable on damage or low health/hunger.

releases.notes:
Some bugs have been fixed, and these features were added:

- Ability to manually press the key while auto clicking
- Ability to keep the auto clicker clicking when disconnecting
- Filter for items in main and off-hand.
- Option to click at the end of the interval instead of directly after enabling

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Pr77Pr77/clickguard/compare/1.0.0-beta+26.3...1.1.0-beta+1.21.10
